_comment: Synthetic fixture for the CStrArray vocabulary type. Mirrors the layout juliac would emit for `struct CStrArray; length::Int64; data::Ptr{Ptr{UInt8}}; end` (JLWInterop, commit 5b0c9ad), with one @ccallable function borrowing a CStrArray argument and one returning an owned one, plus the macro-emitted `jlw_free`/`jlw_free_strings` release entrypoints (JLWInterop, commit 3d84973) so the owning return is `:auto`, not `:mechanical`. The `Ptr{Ptr{UInt8}}` chain and the `Ptr{Nothing}`/synthetic zero-size `Nothing` struct for `jlw_free`'s void return mirror juliac's actual ABI JSON renderings for these types verbatim. The Python emitter must recognize the CStrArray shape (name + full pointer-chain shape, not just the name) and emit from_list/as_list helpers plus an owning-return convert-then-free façade wrapper.
